description: This file defines a serializer class 'TimeOnlyCodec' for serializing and deserializing the 'TimeOnly' struct, using Orleans serialization interfaces and mechanisms. It includes methods for writing and reading 'TimeOnly' instances to and from a wire protocol format, with optimizations such as aggressive inlining.

classes.name: TimeOnlyCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec for TimeOnly type serialization within Orleans framework.

methods.name: WriteField<TBufferWriter>
methods.description: Serializes a TimeOnly value to the buffer, writing the field header and the ticks as Int64.

methods.name: ReadValue<TInput>
methods.description: Deserializes a TimeOnly value from the reader, expecting a 64-bit wire format, constructing TimeOnly from ticks.
